```r
[library](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)([data.table](https://r-datatable.com))
[library](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)([HistData](https://friendly.github.io/HistData/))
 [set.seed](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Random.html)(1983)
galton <- [as.data.table](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/reference/as.data.table.html)(GaltonFamilies)
galton <- galton[gender == "male", .SD[[sample](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sample.html)(.N, 1)], by = family]
galton <- galton[, .(father, son = childHeight)]
```

```r
N <- 25
r <- [replicate](https://rdrr.io/r/base/lapply.html)(1000, galton[[sample](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sample.html)(.N, N, replace = TRUE), [cor](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/cor.html)(father, son)])
[hist](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/hist.html)(r, breaks = 20)
```

```r
galton[, .(father_strata = [factor](https://rdrr.io/r/base/factor.html)([round](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Round.html)(father)), son)] |>
ggplot(aes(father_strata, son)) + 
 geom_boxplot() + 
 geom_point()
```

```r
params <- galton[, .(mu_x = [mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(father), mu_y = [mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(son),
 s_x  = [sd](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/sd.html)(father), s_y  = [sd](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/sd.html)(son),
 r    = [cor](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/cor.html)(father, son))]
 galton |> ggplot(aes(father, son)) + 
 geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
 geom_abline(slope = [with](https://rdrr.io/r/base/with.html)(params, r*s_y/s_x), 
 intercept = [with](https://rdrr.io/r/base/with.html)(params, mu_y - r*s_y/s_x*mu_x))
```

```r
galton[, .(son, z = [round](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Round.html)((father - [mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(father))/[sd](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/sd.html)(father)))][z [%in%](https://rdrr.io/r/base/match.html) -2:2] |>
 ggplot() + 
 stat_qq(aes(sample = son)) +
 facet_wrap( ~ z) 
```
